protocol.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final update; no model or seed selection
protocol.acceptance: Strict swept collision; all five robots cross the opening, reach assigned goals, recover formation, stop, and dwell
protocol.observations: The neighbour control masks the deployed actor input; the training critic and local braking teacher retain identical original measurements
protocol.shared_value: The value head uses actor features and removes the independent critic encoder; actor capacity is unchanged and total training capacity is lower
protocol.uncertainty: Training seed is the replication unit; report mean and sample SD across training seeds
protocol.trajectory_selection: Fixed test seed 61001, episode 0, training seed 2, all four openings; same indices across variants, no outcome-based selection
protocol.limits: Original narrowing geometry only; not arbitrary environments, AFOR superiority, or a hard safety guarantee
